title:
One floor apart.
*$626K difference*

lines.say: You are a buyer at Martin Modern. You bought on the eleventh floor, straight from the developer.
lines.cap: you are a buyer at Martin Modern. you bought *floor 11, from the developer*

lines.say: Four years later, you sold for three point seven million. Your profit? About fifty six thousand.
lines.cap: four years later you sold for $3.7M. profit? *about $56K*

lines.say: Your neighbour one floor below bought the same layout. Same size. Same developer.
lines.cap: your neighbour one floor below. *same layout, same size, same developer*

lines.say: They paid two point eight eight million. You paid three point six four million. That's seven hundred and sixty six thousand more, for one floor.
lines.cap: they paid $2.88M. you paid $3.64M. *$766K more for one floor*

lines.say: The difference? They bought in July twenty seventeen. You bought seven months later, after prices went up.
lines.cap: they bought July 2017. you bought *7 months later, after prices went up*

lines.say: They sold two months before you, for three point five six million. Their profit was about six hundred and eighty two thousand.
lines.cap: they sold 2 months before you, for $3.56M. profit *about $682K*

lines.say: Both exits were almost the same. The entry decided everything.
lines.cap: both exits were almost the same. *the entry decided everything*

lines.say: So before you buy, find the price the exit has already been tested at. Then buy below it.
lines.cap: before you buy, find the *tested exit price*. then buy below it

lines.say: Would you buy early, or wait for a project to prove itself? Comment early, or wait.
lines.cap: buy early or wait? comment *EARLY or WAIT*

source: URA caveats · Martin Modern unit #08 stack, 1,399 sqft · profits before stamp duty & costs
caption:
Same project. Same layout. Same developer. One floor apart. 🏢

The 10th floor buyer made about $682K. The 11th floor buyer made about $56K. Both sold within two months of each other. The difference was the entry price.

Would you buy early, or wait for a project to prove itself? Comment EARLY or WAIT 👇

Profits are before stamp duty and costs. Source: URA transaction data.
